bgm.name: ORAS Misc - Briney Sailing (Crossing the Sea)

parameters: The first time the player boards the ferry after
becoming Champion, Scott will tell them about the
Battle Frontier and invite them there.
\bSomething's come up, so I have to\ndisembark, but am I glad to see you!
\bThere's a place I'd like to invite\nsomeone like you.
\bWhat's the place like?\nYou'll understand when you see it!
\bI've spoken with the ship's Captain\nabout this.
\bThe next time you take a ferry,\nyou should be able to sail to\nthe Battle Frontier.
\bOkay, \PN, I'll be waiting for you\nat the Battle Frontier!
Viewing this event should show the
SS Tidal sailing through the sea
\bWe hope you enjoy your voyage with us.\nFeel free to explore the ship.
\bIt'll be some time before we make land,\nI reckon.
\bYou can rest up in your cabin if you'd\nlike. Your cabin's No. 2.
\bThe bed in there is soft and plushy.\nI can attest to how comfy it is!
\bWe hope you enjoy your voyage on\nour ferry.
\bThis ferry is built to plow through\nfast-running currents.
